title: 4 Indian Army aircraft land on Gujarat highway in strategic demonstration

ai.summary: Indian Army aircraft landed on a Gujarat highway during a strategic demonstration, showcasing potential for specialized military use of national highways.

facts.claim: Four aircraft of the Army successfully landed on the Amritsar-Jamnagar Economic Corridor (NH-754A) in Patan district of Gujarat on November 24
facts.quote: Four aircraft of the Army successfully landed on the Amritsar-Jamnagar Economic Corridor (NH-754A) in Patan district of Gujarat on November 24

facts.claim: The aircraft, comprising two fixed-wing microlight aircraft and two powered hang gliders, belonged to the Army’s Team Mountain Eagles
facts.quote: The aircraft, comprising two fixed-wing microlight aircraft and two powered hang gliders, belonged to the Army’s Team Mountain Eagles

facts.claim: They took off from Kandla Airport as part of the Wings of Valour and Unity Expedition 2026, organised by the Army Adventure Nodal Centre (AANC) at the Military College of Telecommunication Engineering (MCTE), Mhow
facts.quote: They took off from Kandla Airport as part of the Wings of Valour and Unity Expedition 2026, organised by the Army Adventure Nodal Centre (AANC) at the Military College of Telecommunication Engineering (MCTE), Mhow

facts.claim: The demonstration highlighted how specially designed stretches of national highways could potentially serve emergency and strategic requirements, in addition to their regular transportation functions
facts.quote: The demonstration highlighted how specially designed stretches of national highways could potentially serve emergency and strategic requirements, in addition to their regular transportation functions

facts.claim: Union Minister for Road Transport and Highways Nitin Gadkari congratulated Team Mountain Eagles, the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) and other agencies involved in successfully conducting the exercise
facts.quote: Union Minister for Road Transport and Highways Nitin Gadkari congratulated Team Mountain Eagles, the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) and other agencies involved in successfully conducting the exercise

facts.claim: The highway stretch has been designed to withstand a traffic loading of 170 million standard axles (MSA), with a 550 mm pavement crust and a 500 mm subgrade
facts.quote: The highway stretch has been designed to withstand a traffic loading of 170 million standard axles (MSA), with a 550 mm pavement crust and a 500 mm subgrade

facts.claim: The successful landing showcased the engineering capabilities of the corridor and its potential for specialised applications, subject to technical assessment and necessary safety clearances
facts.quote: The successful landing showcased the engineering capabilities of the corridor and its potential for specialised applications, subject to technical assessment and necessary safety clearances

ai.background_note: Indian Army conducted a strategic demonstration by landing aircraft on a Gujarat highway to showcase potential military use of national highways.
